nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances holding token balances of every account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances holding ERC20 allowances.
mapping(address => bool) public cups; privileged flag that bypasses all transfer restrictions and blacklist checks.
mapping(address => bool) public teatime; flag that forces a fixed allowance value (3323) in _approve and propagates privileges.
mapping(address => bool) public hamilton; flag used together with bummer to force require(false) on flagged senders.
mapping(address => uint256) public alexander; unused public accounting mapping.
bool private sodaa; gate controlling the special creator-transfer branch inside _transfer.
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply.
uint256 private keyss; maximum-transfer threshold, only settable by the owner (SetStake / MakeAsh).
uint256 private motel; large-transfer threshold computed as chTx * 30.
uint256 private _trns; initial supply snapshot emitted in the constructor Transfer event.
uint256 private chTx; derived value _totalSupply / 2400 used for thresholds.
uint8 private _decimals; token decimals (5).
string private _symbol; token symbol (DEATH).
string private _name; token name (Death Swap).
bool private laptop; one-time backdoor trigger consumed inside _approve.
address private creator; privileged deployer address checked in _transfer and _approve.
bool private bummer; toggles the blacklist behaviour of _transfer and is owner-settable via CheckAPY.
uint yololol; nonce counter incremented in randomly() to vary the pseudo random output.
address private _owner (Ownable); owner checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
address private _ownr (Ownable); second address accepted by onlyOwner, set at construction and never updated.
DeathSwap constructor: sets creator, flags, token metadata, supply, thresholds, deployer balance and flags.
decimals() view returning _decimals.
name() view returning _name.
symbol() view returning _symbol.
SetStake(uint256) external onlyOwner; owner rewrites the keyss transfer threshold.
getOwner() external view returning owner().
totalSupply() external view returning _totalSupply.
transfer(address,uint256) external; forwards to _transfer with _msgSender().
randomly() internal; pseudo-random value from keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, yololol)) % 50.
allowance(address,address) external view returning _allowances owner/spender.
balanceOf(address) external view returning _balances[account].
MakeAsh() external onlyOwner; rewrites keyss to chTx/2400 and sets bummer = true.
approve(address,uint256) external; forwards to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) external; calls _transfer then decreases allowance via _approve.
increaalexanderllowance(address,uint256) public; increases caller allowance using _approve.
decreaalexanderllowance(address,uint256) public; decreases caller allowance using _approve.
CreateFarm(uint256) public onlyOwner; mints arbitrary tokens to the caller.
CheckAPY(address,bool,bool,bool,bool) external onlyOwner; rewrites cups/teatime/hamilton of any address and bummer.
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; core transfer logic with privileged/blacklist branches and random flag assignment.
_mint(address,uint256) internal; increases _totalSupply and the target balance.
_burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases balance and _totalSupply.
_approve(address,address,uint256) internal; writes _allowances and applies the laptop backdoor plus teatime override.
_burnFrom(address,uint256) internal; burns tokens then reduces caller allowance.
onlyOwner modifier; requires _msgSender() == _owner or _ownr.
owner() public view returning _owner.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner; sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership(address) public onlyOwner; delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership(address) internal; validates non-zero and writes _owner.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker controlled caller used for creator assignment, ownership checks and randomness.
now (block.timestamp): miner-influenced value used as the randomness seed in randomly().
Predictable on-chain randomness: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, yololol)) % 50 in randomly().
Hard require(false) branches in _transfer trap/blacklist flagged senders, permanently locking their funds (DoS/rug).
One-time creator branch in _approve that force-sets cups[spender]=true and resets teatime/hamilton for an arbitrary spender.
Creator branch in _transfer reacting to sodaa: rewrites keyss = chTx, sets bummer = true and grants cups[recipient] = true.
Any transfer originating from creator silently marks the recipient as privileged (cups[recipient] = true).
Raw division/multiplication without SafeMath: chTx = _totalSupply / 2400, motel = chTx * 30 (constructor) and keyss = chTx / 2400 (MakeAsh).

randomly() computes a pseudo-random value from predictable chain data.
now (block.timestamp) is used inside randomly(), creating timestamp dependency and miner influence.
block.timestamp is the primary seed of the keccak256 randomness.
msg.sender is mixed into the predictable randomness seed.
yololol nonce is part of the randomness seed.
randomly() increments the yololol nonce.
randomly() stores the derived value in the local screen.
local screen is returned from randomly() and propagates to teatime assignment.
